snippet.text: theorem bumpMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero (a l u : Fin n → ℝ) (β : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (ha : Function.Injective a) (hl : ∀ j, 0 < l j) (hsep : ∀ i j, i < j → u i < l j) (hcont : ∀ j, Continuous (β j)) (hnonneg : ∀ j t, 0 ≤ β j t) (hnonzero : ∀ j, ∃ t, β j t ≠ 0) (hsupp : ∀ j, Function.support (β j) ⊆ Set.Icc (l j) (u j)) : (bumpMomentMatrix a β).det ≠ 0 — states only the final assertion `det B ≠ 0`, not the integral identity
